purpose: Generate one bounded deterministic PNG raster or mono PCM16 WAV asset from an explicit closed specification, then re-parse the complete emitted container and payload after atomic publication.

properties.path: target .png or .wav file outside the protected live machine body

relationships: creates media bytes instead of requiring the caller to supply pre-existing base64 content
provides reusable deterministic binary assets to mixed projects and browser games

anatomy_refs.basis: Rasterizes ordered rectangle and circle primitives into an exact bounded RGBA8 pixel plane and deterministic PNG container.
Synthesizes explicit square-tone and silence segments into a deterministic bounded mono PCM16 WAV body.
Applies a closed parameter grammar to originate exact output bytes without random or hidden generation state.

limitations: PNG generation is limited to a flat ordered grammar of background, filled rectangles, and filled circles; it is not a general image editor or learned image generator
WAV generation is limited to mono PCM16 square tones and silence; it does not synthesize speech, music semantics, or arbitrary timbres
format validation proves container structure and complete payload shape, not visual appeal, perceptual audio quality, meaning, or suitability
maximum raster side is 2048 pixels, raster area is 4194304 pixels, shape count is 512, tone count is 128, and audio duration is 30000 milliseconds

truth.basis: The normalized specification, specification digest, exact content digest, complete PNG CRC/decompression receipt or WAV structure receipt, and unproven perceptual qualities remain explicit.

agency.basis: The caller chooses the operation, every bounded media parameter, destination, and replacement behavior.

continuity.basis: Publication is atomic, replacement retains a bounded rollback body until post-publication byte and format verification succeeds, and no machine state is changed.

wisdom-before-speed.basis: Strict fields, dimensions, duration, paths, output suffixes, CRCs, decompression, and payload sizes are checked before the result is called validated.
